text:
Zoe (Marketing): quick ask for next week's launch: need a "data-snapshot" visual kit — hero image + webinar frame + social gif pack. keep it credibility-first.
Kai (Design): can you list exact deliverables and priorities?
Zoe (Marketing): priority: hero static (1200x628), webinar frame (1920x1080 with 160px title-safe), slide template (16:9 figma update), social gif pack: 1:1 (1080x1080) and 16:9 (1280x720). GIFs should be ~3s loops and include animated CTA.
Marta (Creative Ops): add figma source, export tokens, and EN/FR/ES copy placeholders. leave horizontal padding for DE. tagging legal for numeric claims.
ExportBot: checklist: PNG @2x, SVG icons, GIF optimization using gifsicle --optimize=3 --colors 128, provide alt text, ensure contrast ratio >=4.5:1.
Tom (Growth): CTA variants for A/B: "See the data" and "Save my seat". Need microcopy for social captions (two options). Also please create logo-left and logo-centered layout variants.
Kai (Design): style preference? illustrative or data-forward?
Zoe (Marketing): data-forward: sparkline + metric pills, but include a small mascot accent for warmth. keep brand tone.
Kai (Design): noted. will mock by Wed EOD, final assets by Monday AM PST. will provide both centered and left lockups.
Marta (Creative Ops): legal: @LegalTeam please review any percent or numeric language in the hero/metrics. attach source bench file id when available.
LegalTeam: will review once WIP is uploaded. numeric claims should reference bench-run-0531 and include a 12px footnote area for methodology blurb.
Kai (Design): upload link when ready: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/data-snapshot-kit — frames: "hero-v1", "webinar-frame-v1", "gif-variants". comment on frames for feedback.
Marta (Creative Ops): export snippet to follow in figma file, but use these settings:
```
PNG: 2x export
SVG: outline strokes
GIF: gifsicle --optimize=3 --colors 128
```
Tom (Growth): social gif spec: 1:1 three-frame loop, 12fps, max 600kb for primary ad. 16:9 max 800kb. add subtle CTA pulse on frame 2.
Kai (Design): will do 3-frame, 12fps, animate CTA pulse and subtle sparkline draw.
Zoe (Marketing): microcopy drafts: Option A: "Serving wins: measured cost × latency" Option B: "Predictable inference economics for your product" Use A on technical channels, B on product comms.
Marta (Creative Ops): note L10n - leave space for longer FR/ES strings, we'll supply translations once assets are final.
Tom (Growth): please include alt text placeholder and a short transcript CTA for the webinar frame (for live captions).
ExportBot: accessibility reminder: visible focus state on CTA and high-contrast fallback colors for dark mode (teal fallback #006f67).
Kai (Design): ok starting sketches. will post WIP and invite expedited review Friday morning.
Zoe (Marketing): thanks all — flag blockers here. final deliverables Monday so comms can draft email and ad copy. :thumbsup:
